title: console-tooling-standup-2026-07-28
content:
Attendees: Evan, Maya, Daniel, Nina, Samir (10m)

Goal: Weekly sync for Console & Tooling (UI work, rollout infra, analytics pipeline). Keep quick — surface blockers and follow-ups.

1) Quick updates
- Evan: Finished PR for rollout UI beta flag (PR #987). Demoed to PMs; they liked the rollout toggle UX but asked for clearer failure states. Deployed to staging. Next: add error banner + telemetry. Blocker: need new API from rollout service to expose per-variant error counts (JIRA-CR-4123).
- Maya: Analytics pipeline ingest for console events is live in dev. Found schema drift on `route_latency_ms` (sometimes string). Adding strict schema validation and backfill transform. Next: run backfill for last 72h. Blocker: access to prod logs for older events — waiting on infra perm change request.
- Daniel: UI work on audit logs view — implemented pagination and server-side filters. Performance improved but we still see 600ms median for large orgs. Plan: add indexing to audit-events table. Blocker: need DB schema migration window (proposal in confluence).
- Nina: Rollouts infra — experimenting with fallback policy changes, added canary % ramp helper. Did dry-run on staging. Observed a race when variant-targeting rules change mid-rollout. Plan: add locking and add unit tests. No current blocker besides time.
- Samir: Small fixes for SDK telemetry integration and updated docs. Raised a PR to add example traces to the SDK quickstart.

2) Action items
- Evan -> Follow up with infra on JIRA-CR-4123 for rollout-service API. If not prioritized by Fri, we’ll add a temporary server-side aggregation to surface error counts in the UI.
- Maya -> Open infra permission ticket and cc PMs; target backfill run Tue 2026-07-30.
- Daniel -> Draft DB migration runbook and propose maintenance window in #sre-sched by EOD Thu.
- Nina -> Add unit tests for rule-change race and verify with canary dry-run next Wed.
- Samir -> Merge SDK telemetry PR after address minor comments; coordinate release with docs team.

3) Blockers / escalations
- Schema drift in analytics is highest priority (affects dashboards/alerts). If infra perms not granted, consider spinning a temporary consumer in your dev env to backfill sanitized payloads.
- DB migration needs SRE buy-in; high-latency audit queries are impacting large customers — mark as P2 and escalate to SRE lead if no response in 48h.

4) Decisions / notes
- Agreed to keep rollout UI beta visible to internal users only for two more weeks before broader QA.
- Will ship the error banner in the next patch (low risk) even if full error-count API is delayed. Banner will link to rollout detail view and show last-known error rate.

5) TODOs for next sync (2026-08-04)
- Show staging demo of error banner + temporary aggregation fallback (Evan).
- Confirm backfill completed and dashboards updated (Maya).
- Post migration runbook and schedule window (Daniel).
- Results from canary race unit tests (Nina).

Misc notes / links:
- Runbook draft: confluence:Console Rollouts Runbook
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/987
- Blocking JIRA: JIRA-CR-4123

Notes to self: keep standups <15m, surface only blockers+decisions. Save deep technical discussion for follow-up thread.
